title: Head of GTM & Growth | Valere Evolve
description:
About Valere Evolve

Valere Evolve is an AI transformation platform that accelerates AI maturity by unifying workforce education, custom development, knowledge capture, and autonomous execution into a single integrated system. Built on three connected pillars — Learn, Build, and Scale — each phase feeds directly into the next. Learning prepares the workforce. Labs builds the systems. Dactic captures institutional knowledge. Conducto orchestrates execution at scale. The result is a continuous transformation loop rather than a stack of disconnected tools and vendors. One platform. From ambition to AI-native operations.


The Role

As Head of GTM & Growth, you are the commercial engine behind Valere Evolve. You will own the full go-to-market strategy and growth execution — from market positioning and pipeline creation to partnership development and revenue scaling. This is not a planning role. You will be expected to build, launch, and iterate in market with the same hands-on urgency that defines the product itself.

You bring demonstrated experience taking AI products and platforms to market, using AI-native tools to scale your own work, and a track record of growing user bases through high-leverage execution. You have done this before. You know what it takes to move a technical platform from early adopters to scaled commercial traction, and you know how to do it with a lean, intelligent team.

This role requires the ability to execute across multiple simultaneous growth motions — and the strategic judgment to know when to lean into each one based on what the market is telling you.


Impact You Will Have

  • Own Market Entry & Expansion: Define and execute the GTM strategy across target segments, verticals, and channels — translating Valere Evolve's platform vision into a repeatable, scalable motion that drives pipeline and accelerates time-to-revenue
  • Build the Growth Engine: Design and personally run the growth infrastructure — outbound sequences, nurture flows, content strategy, and conversion optimization — leveraging AI-native tools to operate at a velocity that outpaces traditional GTM teams
  • Drive Strategic Partnerships: Identify, develop, and close high-leverage partnerships with channel partners, systems integrators, enterprise resellers, and platform ecosystems that unlock distribution and accelerate adoption at scale — structuring agreements that embed platform value directly into partner programs as a retention and growth mechanism
  • Expand from Within: Develop and execute playbooks that convert active client relationships into platform adoption, creating organic expansion from within accounts that are already experiencing Valere's value firsthand
  • Translate Product Into Commercial Narrative: Work closely with product and delivery to develop positioning, messaging, and sales enablement that clearly articulates the value of the Learn → Build → Scale loop to enterprise buyers
  • Convert Strategy to Revenue: Build the frameworks, KPIs, and real-time dashboards that connect GTM activity to pipeline health, conversion rates, expansion revenue, and customer acquisition cost
  • Scale the User Base: Execute demand generation and account-based programs that grow the active user base across direct, partner-led, and paid acquisition channels — with measurable growth targets tied to platform adoption milestones


Key Responsibilities

  • GTM Strategy & Multi-Motion Execution — Own the full go-to-market roadmap including ICP definition, pricing frameworks, and launch execution. You will design and operate across multiple distinct growth motions simultaneously, building the systems to manage, measure, and optimize each one with clarity and speed
  • Partnership Development & Distribution — Source and structure strategic partnerships that create meaningful distribution leverage — including experience embedding platform capabilities and educational content directly into partner programs, proposals, and client engagements. Own the full partnership lifecycle from identification through activation and ongoing revenue contribution
  • Account Expansion & Organic Growth — Build and execute the internal playbooks, enablement materials, and account triggers that convert existing relationships into platform adoption and drive organic growth from within active engagements. Identify the signals that indicate expansion readiness and move on them
  • Targeted Outbound & Enterprise Penetration — Execute precision outbound campaigns targeting key individuals and internal champions inside large organizations. Build the entry-point strategy, manage the champion relationship, and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption to grow platform footprint organically from the inside out
  • Paid Acquisition & Influence-Driven Demand — Build and manage a paid acquisition strategy that drives platform awareness and qualified demand at scale — including the identification and activation of credible voices in the AI and enterprise transformation space to amplify reach and accelerate top-of-funnel growth
  • AI-Native Operations — Build and operate GTM workflows using AI-native tools — from prospecting automation and pipeline intelligence to content generation and deal acceleration. You use the tools. You don't delegate the tools.
  • Revenue & Pipeline Ownership — Work directly with sales and leadership to manage pipeline, forecast accuracy, and growth targets. You are accountable to the number.
  • Market Intelligence — Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, buyer behavior, and adoption trends to sharpen positioning and identify untapped growth vectors across all active acquisition channels
  • Cross-Functional Alignment — Serve as the connective layer between product, delivery, and commercial teams — ensuring GTM motion is tightly integrated with product roadmap, customer outcomes, and client-facing team capabilities


What We Look For

  • Experience: 4+ years in GTM, growth, or commercial leadership roles, with at least 2 years of demonstrated experience bringing AI products or platforms to market in a hands-on capacity
  • AI Product GTM (Required): Proven track record of taking AI-native products or platforms from early traction to scaled commercial adoption. You understand the buyer journey, the objections, the trust barriers, and what actually moves enterprise deals forward
  • AI-Native Operator (Required): You actively use and scale your work with AI tools. You have built GTM workflows, systems, and processes powered by AI automation — not as a pilot, but as standard operating procedure
  • Multi-Motion GTM Execution (Required): Demonstrated ability to design and run multiple simultaneous growth motions — partner-led distribution, account expansion, precision outbound, and paid acquisition — and the strategic maturity to resource and prioritize across them as market conditions evolve
  • Partnership Builder: Demonstrated ability to develop and close strategic partnerships that create real distribution leverage — including experience structuring agreements where platform access or educational content is embedded as a core component of the partnership value proposition
  • Account Expansion Experience: Proven ability to convert existing client or customer relationships into product adoption — building the internal plays and triggers that drive organic growth from within active accounts
  • Enterprise Outbound & Champion Development: Hands-on experience running targeted outbound to individual practitioners and decision-influencers inside large organizations, with the ability to build internal champions and develop the expansion motion that follows initial adoption
  • Paid Acquisition & Influencer Marketing: Working knowledge of paid acquisition strategy in B2B and B2B2C contexts, including performance measurement, creator or partner identification, and building programs that sustain organic reach alongside paid investment
  • Strategic Mindset with Execution Bias: You can build the roadmap and execute it in the same week. You are equally comfortable in a board-level positioning conversation and building the outbound sequence that follows it
  • Data-Driven Growth: Fluency in GTM analytics, funnel metrics, and revenue operations. You build dashboards, track what matters, and adjust based on signal — not assumption
  • Communication: Ability to translate complex platform capabilities into compelling narratives for enterprise buyers, partners, and executive stakeholders across every channel and motion
  • Builder Mentality: You don't wait for a team or a budget to grow. You find leverage, build fast, and scale what works
  • Genuine Enthusiasm for AI: Deep curiosity about the evolving AI landscape and a conviction that AI transformation is the defining enterprise challenge of this decade


How to Apply

To be considered for this role, all applicants must submit a brief Loom or video recording (5 minutes or less) shared with , including two things:

  • A personal introduction — who you are, what drives you, and why this role and this moment in AI transformation excites you
  • A concrete GTM example — walk us through a specific product or platform you've taken to market. We want the real story: the motion you chose, the obstacles you hit, how you adapted, and the measurable outcome. Slide decks and polished narratives are not what we're looking for. Show us how you think and execute.

Submissions without a video will not be reviewed. We are not evaluating production quality — we are evaluating clarity of thought, commercial instinct, and evidence of hands-on execution.

ÜBER LEVITY:

Levity ist eine No-Code-KI-Automatisierungsplattform, die es Unternehmen ermöglicht, KI-gestützte Workflows zu entwickeln und einzusetzen, ohne Programmierkenntnisse zu benötigen. Levity unterstützt Teams dabei, wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie die Verarbeitung von E-Mails, Dokumenten, Bildern und Kundenanfragen zu automatisieren, indem KI-Modelle mit ihren eigenen Daten trainiert werden.

Levity wurde 2018 gegründet, hat 10 Mio. USD eingesammelt und wird von führenden Investoren unterstützt, darunter Balderton Capital, eine der renommiertesten Venture-Capital-Gesellschaften Europas, sowie Angular Ventures. 

Mit HQ in Deutschland und Chicago und einer globalen Präsenz ist die Plattform darauf ausgelegt, KI auch für nicht-technische Teams zugänglich zu machen, indem sie die Erstellung und Implementierung von Automatisierungen über eine einfache visuelle Benutzeroberfläche ermöglicht. Dadurch können Unternehmen ihre Workflows optimieren, manuelle Arbeit reduzieren und die operative Effizienz in Bereichen wie Operations, Customer Support und Backoffice-Prozessen steigern. Levity wird insbesondere von weltweit führenden Logistikunternehmen eingesetzt.

Einfach gesagt: Levity ermöglicht es Unternehmen, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse mithilfe von KI zu automatisieren – ganz ohne Engineers.


ÜBER DIE ROLLE DES ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE:

Wir suchen einen (Sr.) Enterprise Account Executive , der ein neues Geschäft vorantreibt und strategische Partnerschaften mit globalen Marktführern in der Logistik aufbaut. Du bist verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss von hochkarätigen Enterprise-Kunden, mit dem Ziel, langfristige Partnerschaften im Multi-Millionen-Dollar-Bereich aufzubauen.

Dies ist eine kommerzielle Rolle mit großem Einfluss, mit Fokus auf das Navigieren in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen, das Identifizieren wertvoller Use Cases und das Generieren signifikanter neuer Umsätze. Die Position berichtet direkt an die Gründer.


Wesentliche Verantwortlichkeiten

• Enterprise Sales Ownership: Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales Cycle für strategische Enterprise-Prospects, von der ersten Ansprache und Discovery bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

• New Revenue Generation: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden, mit Fokus auf wirkungsstarke Use Cases und groß angelegte Deployments.

• Stakeholder Management: Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen Organisationsstrukturen und baust Beziehungen zu C-Level Executives, Entscheidungsträgern und operativen Führungskräften über verschiedene Tochtergesellschaften und Länder hinweg auf.

• Commercial Strategy: Du führst kommerzielle Gespräche, entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Angebote und verhandelst Verträge, um langfristige Enterprise-Partnerschaften zu sichern.

• Collaboration: Du arbeitest während des Sales-Prozesses eng mit Solutions Engineers und Produktteams zusammen, um Lösungen zu gestalten, die den Kundenanforderungen entsprechen und gleichzeitig erfolgreiche Abschlüsse ermöglichen.


Wen wir suchen und wer in dieser Rolle erfolgreich sein wird:

• Experience: 5+ Jahre Erfahrung als Enterprise Account Executive oder im Vertrieb, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz beim Abschluss komplexer Deals innerhalb multinationaler Organisationen.

 • Startup DNA: Erfahrung in einem wachstumsstarken Startup-Umfeld ist essenziell. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, ohne die Ressourcen eines Großkonzerns zu arbeiten. Du bist hands-on und bringst eine ausgeprägte Ownership-Mentalität mit.

• Technically competent to navigate AI discussions: Auch wenn du kein Engineer bist, wirst du mit technischen Führungskräften, Operations-Leads und deren Teams sprechen und ihnen vermitteln, welchen enormen Mehrwert Levity für ihre Organisation schaffen kann. Deshalb brauchst du ein solides Verständnis von KI sowie ein gutes technisches Grundverständnis.

• Language: Deutsch auf Muttersprachiveau/C2 und fließendes Englisch. 

• Industry Background: Ein großes Plus ist Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Logistik, Supply Chain oder 3PL. Gleichzeitig sind wir offen für Top-Performer aus anderen komplexen Branchen, z. B. Telco, Manufacturing etc.

• Gemeinsam mit den Gründern wirst du zudem das Gesicht von Levity auf Konferenzen und Events sein. Du solltest gerne reisen, um an Konferenzen teilzunehmen und Kunden weltweit zu besuchen. Die meisten Konferenzen finden in Europa und den USA statt, während sich die Kunden global verteilen. Es wird keine monatlich feste Reisetätigkeit geben, aber einige Monate werden reiseintensiver sein als andere.


Vergütung & Benefits:

• Target Earnings: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit Fixum + Bonus + Equity.

• Incentives: Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell mit starkem Fokus auf Expansion Revenue.

• Impact: Direkter Zugang zum Leadership-Team und die Möglichkeit, unseren Enterprise-Sales-Playbook aktiv mitzugestalten.

• International team: Levity zählt über 20 talentierte Mitarbeitende und wächst weiter. Das Team ist in Europa (Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal, Polen, Schweden), Brasilien, APAC und weiteren Regionen vertreten.

• Remote: Du kannst von überall in Europa aus arbeiten. Levity hat außerdem ein Büro in Berlin, falls du eine hybride oder Office-basierte Rolle bevorzugst.

• Travel: Du solltest dich mit umfangreicher Reisetätigkeit wohlfühlen, um Kunden weltweit zu treffen und bei Bedarf an Konferenzen teilzunehmen.


Additional notes:

  • Interview will be conducted in English, as the language is mandatory for this role
  • All applicants are carefully reviewed by our team daily and if we see a strong match to the role, you will be contacted via LinkedIn or e-mail.
  •  If you're not contacted, we believe it's not a match this time and will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency and creativity. title: Product Manager (AI features)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.



About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.

SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • Be a part of a high-impact team building industry-defining B2B software and AI tools.
  • Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.
  • Remote-friendly and flexible work culture.


About The Role:

At SpendHound, we are on a mission to help Finance and Procurement teams gain real-time visibility and control over their software costs. Our platform simplifies software spend tracking and provides actionable insights, delivering cost-savings to 1000+ companies around the world.

We are building towards an agent-first approach to vendor selection and price benchmarking and are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead the development of new AI features on our roadmap. You will help define the product vision, collaborate with engineering and design teams, and work closely with customers to achieve this goal. This role is ideal for someone looking for a high degree of ownership and passionate about building tools that help business operate more effectively.


As Our Product Manager, You Will:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Define and drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for SpendHound’s new AI features.
  • Market & User Research: Conduct user interviews, analyze customer feedback, and study market trends to identify opportunities for product enhancements.
  • Feature Development: Work closely with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams to build a world-class vendor intelligence platform.
  • Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring product decisions align with real user needs and business objectives.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in Product Management with 1+ years of experience building AI products.
  • Ability to work closely with engineers in a highly technical environment to deliver AI features.
  • Strong ability to translate customer pain points into impactful product features.
  • Comfortable analyzing data, doing error analysis, and using insights to guide product decisions.
  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and procurement expert teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment and drive projects from concept to launch.


Nice To Have:

  • Previous experience with working on B2B products .
  • Experience with Claude, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools.
  • Understanding of the software purchasing process within large organizations.
  • Familiarity with SQL, data visualization tools, or basic coding knowledge


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

  • Trading Comparables (Comps)

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

Experiência com CoE Starter Kit e práticas de adoção/governança em escala.

title: Analista de Marketing
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Analista de Marketing Pl. abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso!


Sua missão:


Executar as estratégias de marketing e comunicação, garantindo padronização da marca, suporte às áreas internas e entrega consistente de materiais, eventos e ações comerciais, alinhado às diretrizes corporativas.

  • Organizar eventos, ativações e ações comerciais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores, orçamentos e prazos;
  • Consolidar relatórios mensais da unidade, alinhados ao corporativo.


Requisitos:


  • Superior em Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na área;
  • Vivência com organização de eventos externos;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel, PowerPoint e ferramentas básicas de criação (Canva e similares).


Vantagens/Benefícios:

title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
About the Company

Space Dinosaurs builds fast, high-converting ecommerce experiences for the world's top brands, with a focus on conversion rate and revenue optimization. We're a specialist e-commerce and creative strategy firm that uses AI-augmented engineering and our CDN engineering heritage to deliver high-performance, scalable digital retail experiences that deliver exceptional revenue performance and growth. Together, we're a global team of talented designers, engineers, strategists, and operators who like solving hard problems, shipping work we're proud of, and tying our output to measurable results. Built on decades of retail technology expertise, we're redefining how retail grows. We are recognized by many of the world's leading retail and consumer brands for designing and building the fastest, most resilient, future-ready websites and applications that consistently deliver measurable outcomes in revenue.



About the Role

We design and ship headless commerce frontends for major retail brands — high-traffic storefronts where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly impacts conversion rates and revenue. You'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams: designing front-end architectures, breaking epics into implementable stories, establishing the coding standards that keep a multi-team codebase coherent, and resolving ambiguity before it reaches a sprint. You'll work directly with clients during discovery and sprint planning, partner with leads and senior engineers through design reviews and ADRs, and collaborate async-first across time zones. The path leads to Principal Architecture with client-facing strategic influence across our commerce practice.


Responsibilities

  • Design and own front-end architectures using Next.js, React, and TypeScript for enterprise commerce implementations
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity
  • Lead architectural decisions on rendering strategies, state management, caching, and performance optimization — and document them in ADRs
  • Drive Core Web Vitals performance across your delivery team, establishing standards engineers build against in every PR
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably
  • Collaborate with clients during discovery to translate business needs into scalable, pragmatic architecture roadmaps
  • Resolve technical ambiguity before sprint — unblocking engineers and escalating architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation

Qualifications

  • Proven architectural experience designing front-end systems and leading distributed engineering teams (3+ people)
  • Deep proficiency in Next.js (App Router, React Server Components), React, TypeScript, and modern web architecture — SSR strategies, edge computing, serverless patterns
  • Performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals optimization, CDN configuration, caching strategies, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Strong written and verbal English — you'll align technical work with client expectations, explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders, and define the conventions engineers build against
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation — not just personal AI tool usage, but structuring how teams work with agents: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, and decomposing features so that agent-generated output is reviewable and reliable


Required Skills

  • Familiarity with commerce platforms (Shopify Storefront API, SFCC Composable Storefront, Big Commerce)
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms (Contentful, Sanity, Contentstack)


Preferred Skills

  • Tools: React, Next.js, TypeScript
  • Shopify Plus / Salesforce Commerce Cloud / Big Commerce / SCAYLE
  • Vercel, CI/CD pipelines
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code, ChatGPT
  • Jest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence


What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company.
  • AI: Premium AI tooling licenses (Cursor and/or Claude Code) for your entire team, with organizational support for building AI-first delivery practices.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

  • Experiência com dados financeiros ou sistemas críticos

title: Oficial Operacional Geral
description:
Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas)


Procuramos um Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas) para integrar nossa equipe de administração de imóveis por temporada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ. Se você é proativo, tem múltiplas habilidades em manutenção e busca uma oportunidade dinâmica, essa vaga é para você!


Sobre a Vaga


Sua missão será garantir que nossos imóveis estejam sempre em perfeitas condições para os hóspedes. A rotina envolverá manutenções preventivas e corretivas em diversos apartamentos, além de atendimentos emergenciais que exigem agilidade e foco na solução.


O que você vai fazer:


Realizar manutenção geral e reparos, incluindo mas não se limitando:


•  Trocar lâmpadas, chuveiros, torneiras, sifões de pia, tomadas e interruptores simples, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Ajustar portas de armário, dobradiças, puxadores e maçanetas, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Aplicar silicone e vedação simples em pias, cubas e box, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Instalar suportes, prateleiras, varões e quadros com furadeira e parafusadeira, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Tampar pequenos furos com massa corrida (correções estéticas pontuais), e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Testar e reiniciar equipamentos como roteador, TV, ar-condicionado e eletrodomésticos pequenos, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Desentupir pias, ralos e vasos sanitários com desentupidor manual ou produto químico de uso doméstico, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Realizar montagem e instalações simples.


•  Montar móveis de pequeno porte seguindo manual (ex: cama box, mesa, cadeira, cômoda, criado-mudo, estantes), e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Utilizar ferramentas manuais e elétricas leves de forma segura, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Realizar acompanhamento de serviços de terceiros.


•  Estar presente nos apartamentos durante montagens, instalações ou manutenções feitas por empresas contratadas, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Abrir e fechar o imóvel, liberar o acesso e acompanhar a execução dos serviços, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Reportar à equipe qualquer problema, atraso ou necessidade observada durante o acompanhamento, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Realizar vistorias preventivas (sob escala definida).


•  Verificar funcionamento de iluminação, tomadas e interruptores, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Checar funcionamento de ar-condicionado, TVs, Wi-Fi e eletrodomésticos, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Conferir descargas, torneiras, vazamentos e funcionamento hidráulico geral, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Avaliar portas, trincos, fechaduras mecânicas e digitais, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Identificar sinais de desgaste, manutenção pendente ou problemas em geral e informar à equipe, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Manter comunicação constante com a equipe.


•  Utilizar aplicativos para celular para enviar fotos, registros e atualizações sobre cada atendimento ou vistoria, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Reportar com clareza problemas detectados durante as atividades, e outras atividades relacionadas.


•  Manter postura profissional e comunicação objetiva, e outras atividades relacionadas.


As atividades que listamos aqui são as principais, mas o trabalho pode ter outras coisas parecidas que apareçam no dia a dia.


O que Buscamos em Você


•  Experiência comprovada em manutenção geral, com habilidades diversas (elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, pequenos reparos).


•  Capacidade de organização e planejamento para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.


•  Proatividade na identificação de problemas e busca de soluções antes que se tornem urgências.


•  Olhar atento aos detalhes para identificar pequenas falhas e realizar acabamentos impecáveis.


•  Bom raciocínio lógico para diagnosticar problemas complexos e encontrar as melhores soluções.


•  Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão em situações emergenciais, mantendo a calma e a eficiência.


•  Excelente gestão do tempo para cumprir prazos e otimizar o roteiro de atendimentos.


•  Foco em soluções e capacidade de encontrar alternativas criativas para desafios inesperados.


•  Familiaridade com o uso seguro e a manutenção básica de ferramentas (manuais e elétricas).

•  Postura ética e discrição ao lidar com a privacidade dos hóspedes e dos imóveis.


•  Agilidade e prontidão para atender a chamados de emergência.


•  Excelente comunicação e proatividade.


•  Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e se deslocar rapidamente entre os imóveis.


•  Possuir veículo próprio (preferencialmente moto) e CNH válida é um diferencial, com auxílio específico para o uso.


  • •  Experiência prévia em manutenção de imóveis para temporada, hotelaria, predial e/ou residencial será um grande diferencial.




Formato de Contratação e Remuneração


•  Contrato de trabalho no regime CLT, com jornada de 44 horas semanais.


•  Horário Fixo: De segunda a sábado, das 09h às 17:20h.


•  Remuneração Bruta Mensal: R$ 1.621,00 + 30% de adicional de periculosidade (eletricidade)


•  Benefícios:


•  Vale-Refeição no valor de R$ 22,00 por dia, podendo chegar no mês a R$ 572,00.


•  Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Corporate Attorney (US-Licensed, LATAM-Based)
description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking a US-licensed Corporate Attorney based in LATAM to take ownership of ongoing corporate legal work across a portfolio of startup clients.

This is a high-trust, senior role for someone who operates independently, understands business context, and can act as a true partner to founders and operators. You’ll manage day-to-day corporate matters across ~200 clients, working closely with leadership and integrating deeply into the team.

This is not a temporary or advisory-only position. We’re looking for someone who wants to embed long-term, take ownership, and grow with the firm .

What you’ll do

Corporate Legal Execution

  • Handle ongoing corporate matters across a portfolio of startup clients
  • Draft, review, and manage contracts and transactional documents
  • Support company formations, fund structures, and corporate governance
  • Prepare and review board resolutions, operating agreements, and related documents

Startup & Venture Support

  • Advise on venture financings (seed through growth stages)
  • Support founders through entity structuring, cap table decisions, and governance
  • Work closely with tools like Carta and similar platforms

Client Management

  • Manage relationships with 3–4 clients per day on average
  • Act as ongoing outside counsel embedded within client operations
  • Provide clear, pragmatic legal guidance aligned with business goals

Internal Collaboration

  • Work directly with the CEO, CFO, and core team
  • Participate in regular team syncs and collaborate cross-functionally
  • Help build a more efficient in-house legal capability as the firm scales

What we are looking for

Core Requirements

  • Active US Bar license (required)
  • Based in LATAM (Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia preferred)
  • Strong experience in corporate law for startups
  • Background supporting venture financings, fund formation, and governance
  • Experience working with US-based clients or companies
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Domain of Carta software tool

Who you are

  • Senior, independent operator who does not require hand-holding
  • Comfortable owning workstreams end-to-end across multiple clients
  • Strong business judgment, not just legal theory
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, but highly self-directed
  • Intuitive, proactive, and able to understand context quickly
  • Interested in long-term growth, not short-term engagements


Why join

  • High ownership: Be the core corporate legal partner across a large client base
  • Startup exposure: Work across a wide range of venture-backed companies
  • Flexibility: Fully remote, high-autonomy environment
  • Growth: Opportunity to become a foundational part of the firm’s long-term structure

Interview Process

  • Initial conversation with CEO

  • Final decision

Role Structure & Compensation

  • Location: Remote (LATAM-based)
  • Type: Contract-to-full-time (open to both)
  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience
  • Benefits: PTO & holidays, full benefits for full-time role.


If interested, also please email us with your resume and cover letter at

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Operations Support | AI-First | Remote (LATAM)

Salary - USD $18,000 – $21,000/year  DOE + Monthly Health Insurance Bonus (~$100/mo)

Schedule - Monday–Friday, 8:30AM–5:30 PM EST

PTO - 10 days/year (accrual) | U.S. Holidays Off

Payments - Bi-weekly

Location - Remote — Latin America


This isn’t an assistant role where you wait to be told what to do.

This is a role where you own the details, drive the follow-through, and hold leadership accountable—even when it’s uncomfortable. If you need permission to take initiative, this isn’t the right fit. If you’re the person who sees what needs to happen and makes it happen, keep reading.


About Carbon Residential

Carbon Residential is a fast-growing, U.S.-based real estate investment firm managing a diverse portfolio of residential and commercial properties across multiple states. We operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging automation, data intelligence, and modern technology to drive operational excellence, scalability, and long-term sustainability. Efficiency isn’t optional here. It’s embedded in how we work.


We’re building something different. A company where people take ownership, where systems replace chaos, and where the right person in the right seat can have an outsized impact. That’s what this role is.


About the Role

You’ll serve as the right hand to the Director of Operations—providing direct administrative, operational, and financial support while acting as the accountability engine that keeps everything moving forward. This is not a “take notes and schedule meetings” role. This is a role where you own systems, chase down loose ends, flag what’s falling through the cracks, and push back when things aren’t getting done—including pushing back on the person you report to.


The Director will be the first to tell you: he’s a big-picture operator, not a details person. He needs someone who fills that gap—someone who tracks every commitment, follows up relentlessly, and isn’t afraid to say “Hey, this still isn’t done and it needs to be.” If that sounds like you, this role will give you more autonomy, exposure, and impact than most EA positions ever will.


You should be highly organized, financially literate, tech-savvy, and comfortable using AI tools daily to multiply your output and improve workflows across the organization.


What Makes You Different

We’ve titled this section intentionally. We’re not looking for a generic set of skills—we’re looking for a specific type of person. The right hire has these qualities baked into who they are:


  • You’re a Self-Starter. You don’t wait for a task list. You look around, see what needs to happen, and do it. When you run out of assignments, you go find the next problem to solve. Downtime is your enemy.
  • You Take Initiative. You don’t ask “Should I do this?”—you do it and report back. You bring solutions, not questions. You anticipate needs before they’re communicated.
  • You Have Relentless Follow-Through. Nothing falls off your radar. If something was promised by Tuesday, you’re checking on it Monday. If a vendor said they’d send an invoice, you’re following up. You close every loop, every time.
  • You Hold People Accountable. This is the big one. You’re not afraid to hold your own boss accountable. If he said he’d review something and hasn’t, you follow up. If a deadline is slipping, you flag it. You do this professionally, respectfully, and firmly. You understand that accountability isn’t confrontation—it’s how things actually get done.
  • You’re Tough When It Matters. You know when to nudge and when to push. You don’t let things slide because it’s easier. You care enough about the outcome to have the uncomfortable conversation. You’re the person who makes the people around you better by refusing to let standards slip.
  • You’re Committed to Your Own Growth. You’re not just looking for a job—you’re looking for a trajectory. You invest in yourself personally and professionally, and you want to work somewhere that does the same. At Carbon, as the company grows, you grow with it. The Director genuinely cares about developing his people and believes that when you win, the whole team wins.


A note on availability and boundaries.

This role requires a willingness to be responsive to after-hours communications when they come up. Things move fast in real estate and sometimes decisions can’t wait until morning. That said, the Director respects boundaries and prioritizes work-life balance. You won’t be expected to be on-call 24/7—but when something urgent comes through, we need someone who’s willing to engage. It’s a two-way street built on mutual respect.


Key Responsibilities

Accountability & Follow-Through

  • Own the Director’s task list, commitments, and deadlines—track every open item and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Follow up proactively on outstanding deliverables across departments, vendors, and leadership
  • Send reminders, escalate delays, and push back professionally when timelines are slipping
  • Maintain a running accountability tracker—who owes what, by when, and what’s overdue
  • Serve as the “closing engine” that turns conversations and commitments into completed tasks

AI-Driven Operations & Process Optimization

  • Use AI tools (Claude, Gemini, workflow automations) to draft communications, summarize reports, and streamline documentation
  • Maintain AI-assisted trackers, dashboards, and reporting systems
  • Continuously improve operational processes using AI-enhanced workflows

Administrative & Executive Support

  • Manage the Director’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Track ongoing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables using digital project management systems
  • Maintain organized, searchable digital filing systems
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture action items, and ensure follow-up execution

Financial & Reporting Support

  • Assist in preparing financial reports, expense summaries, and budget trackers
  • Review invoices, receipts, and statements for accuracy before approval
  • Support monthly reporting cycles with clear, data-backed updates
  • Leverage AI tools to analyze financial data and flag discrepancies or trends

Property-Level Coordination & Communication

  • Support property-level day-to-day operations as directed
  • Contact vendors for invoices, and service updates—and follow up until closed


Our Core Values

At Carbon, our core values aren’t aspirational posters on a wall. They’re how we operate daily. The right person for this role lives these naturally:


  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen) — You’re constantly looking for ways to improve yourself, your systems, and the organization. Yesterday’s process is tomorrow’s improvement opportunity.
  • High Integrity — You do the right thing even when no one is watching. You’re honest, transparent, and trustworthy with sensitive information.
  • Discipline — You show up every day, do the work, and follow through. No excuses, no shortcuts. Discipline is what separates good from great.
  • Build to Last — You think long-term. You build systems and processes that scale, not band-aids that break in a month.
  • Connection — You build strong relationships across teams, vendors, and stakeholders. Communication is your superpower.
  • All In, All Out — When you’re in, you’re fully in. You bring energy, focus, and commitment to everything you touch.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2–3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Operations/Finance Coordinator
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)—you will communicate daily with U.S.-based leadership
  • Strong financial literacy and exceptional attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and self-direct
  • High comfort level with AI tools and automation platforms—this is non-negotiable
  • Proven track record of holding people accountable and driving follow-through in a professional setting

Technical & AI Skills

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack,, and similar collaboration tools
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude, Gemini, AI writing assistants, workflow automation platforms)
  • Ability to create structured prompts that generate accurate, actionable outputs
  • Strong digital organization and documentation practices

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with property management or accounting software (Yardi, or similar)
  • Understanding of real estate operations and multi-property support
  • Experience building dashboards, SOPs, or process documentation systems


Who Thrives in This Role


You thrive here if you’re the person who:

•  Sees a problem and fixes it before anyone asks

•  Constantly asks: “How can this be automated or improved?”

•  Has been told “You’re more organized than my actual manager”

•  Isn’t intimidated by holding senior leadership accountable

•  Treats AI as a core professional skill, not a novelty

•  Takes pride in being the person who never drops the ball


What’s in It for You

  • A forward-thinking, AI-enabled work environment where your tech skills are valued and encouraged
  • Direct exposure to U.S. leadership and real estate investment operations—not a middleman, not a body shop
  • A stable, long-term remote opportunity with consistent hours and bi-weekly pay
  • Health insurance bonus (~$100/month) to support your coverage
  • 10 days PTO annually plus U.S. holidays off
  • Real autonomy and real impact—your work directly shapes how the company operates
  • Work directly for a leader who genuinely wants to see his people grow and will invest in your development


One last thing.

If you read this job description and thought “That’s me”—we want to hear from you. We’d rather hire someone with the right DNA and train the technical gaps than hire a perfect resume with no backbone. Show us who you are.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases
description:
Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP Databases


Location: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


About the Role


We're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement.

This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.


What You'll Own

  • OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters
  • OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads
  • Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline
  • Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores
  • Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration


Tech Stack

  • OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ)
  • OLAP: ClickHouse 25.x
  • CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse
  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)


Requirements

  • 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role
  • Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations
  • Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns
  • Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication)
  • Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systems



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines
  • Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2)
  • Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection
  • dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools
  • Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases
  • Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Designer de Produto
description:
• Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia, e você precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


  • O desafio

Você vai atuar junto de um time de ~20 de Produto (PM, devs, dados) para evoluir a experiência e o produto de ponta a ponta.

Essa não é uma posição para quem usa IA eventualmente. É para quem já incorporou IA no workflow e tem senso crítico para saber quando usar e quando não usar.


  • O que você vai fazer
  • Conduzir pesquisa com usuários (entrevistas, testes, descoberta contínua) e transformar insights em direção clara — usando IA para acelerar síntese e análise de feedback
  • Usar IA ativamente no workflow: geração de variações, rascunhos de stories, análise de dados qualitativos, automação de etapas repetitivas e muito mais
  • Conduzir iterações rápidas de protótipos (do rascunho ao validado) antes de buildar, com apoio de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade sem perder qualidade
  • Manter sistema e consistência na experiência: design system, padrões, acessibilidade e handoff
  • Trabalhar com métricas e experimentação (funil, eventos, testes A/B) para orientar decisões com evidência



  • O que buscamos
  • Uso real de IA no dia a dia de design: Cria workflows, usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Galileo AI ou similares. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito.
  • Maturidade de discovery: Sabe definir problema, hipótese, método certo e chegar em decisão com evidência.
  • Qualidade de escrita: User stories claras, critérios de aceite objetivos e comunicação direta com o time.
  • Senso de produto e negócio (fintech): Entende trade-offs de conversão, retenção, risco e compliance.
  • Sistema e consistência: Experiência com design system, padrões e cuidado com edge cases.
  • Métricas e experimentação: Conforto em acompanhar impacto, instrumentação básica e aprendizado contínuo.



  • O que não buscamos
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar imagens bonitas, sem integrar ao processo de design e descoberta
  • Perfis focados só em execução visual, sem interesse em produto, dados e estratégia
  • Falta de experiência com sistemas em produção e ambientes com ritmo acelerado



  • O que oferecemos
  • 100% remoto | Contratação PJ
  • Remuneração: de R$20k – R$25k a combinar.
  • Autonomia real para evoluir o design do produto
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e disseminar



Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.


Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .


Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.


Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.


Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.


Missão do cargo:


Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;


Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.


Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.
