title: Business Strategy Consultant
description:
The Problem We Solve

Organizations collect mountains of data about their customers — and still struggle to act on it. They run surveys, build dashboards, and generate reports, but often lack the structured thinking to turn those outputs into decisions that actually change the business.


This role exists to close that gap.


You will work at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and executive storytelling — helping enterprise clients in financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications understand what their data is telling them and what to do about it.


Who You Are

You are the kind of person who can't look at a dataset without forming a hypothesis. You structure problems before you solve them. You know that a great insight buried in a dense slide is a wasted insight — and you take pride in turning complexity into clarity.


More specifically:

  • You are highly analytical and structured in your thinking — frameworks come naturally to you.
  • You are intellectually curious and comfortable working with ambiguity and open-ended problems.
  • You translate complex analyses into simple, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
  • You are motivated by the full arc: from raw data to strategic recommendation to business impact.
  • You work well independently and collaboratively, and you're not precious about your ideas


What Makes This Role Challenging

You'll often need to build the analytical framework before you can answer the question. Clients don't always know what they need — part of your job is to figure that out alongside them. You'll be expected to move fluidly between quantitative analysis and executive-level communication, sometimes within the same day. This is not a role for someone who wants a clear playbook. It's for someone who wants to write one.


What You Will Work On

  • Diagnosing drivers of customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational performance across enterprise clients.
  • Structuring insights from large datasets and Voice of Customer programs into strategic recommendations.
  • Developing analytical frameworks that connect behavioral and operational data to business outcomes.
  • Building executive presentations and data-driven narratives for C-level and senior stakeholders.
  • Contributing to consulting proposals and new service offerings — translating insights into commercial value propositions.
  • Supporting the development of consulting methodologies, tools, and analytical approaches.


Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Strategic Thinking

  • Translate complex business problems into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis using Excel and other analytical tools.
  • Develop hypotheses and insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Connect customer behavior, operational metrics, and business performance in coherent analytical narratives


Executive Communication

  • Build executive presentations that communicate findings with clarity and conviction.
  • Synthesize large volumes of information into concise, actionable messages.
  • Adapt communication style to different senior stakeholder audiences.


Commercial & Proposal Development

  • Support the development of consulting proposals and commercial presentations.
  • Help structure value propositions that connect analytical insights to client business challenges.
  • Collaborate in preparing business development materials and new service offerings.


Required Skills

  • Advanced PowerPoint — you build slides that tell a story, not just display data.
  • Advanced Excel — data modeling, analysis, and structuring large datasets.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical framework development.
  • Ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative inputs into strategic recommendations


Nice to Have:

  • SQL, Python, or R.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other BI tools.
  • Experience with customer analytics, Voice of Customer programs, or customer journey analysis.
  • Familiarity with CX platforms such as Medallia, Qualtrics, or similar.


Experience & Background

3–6 years in roles such as:

  • Strategy consulting;
  • Business analytics or insights;
  • Strategic planning;
  • Business intelligence or data-driven product roles.


Industry experience in financial services, insurance, retail, telecommunications, or technology is a strong plus.


Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, or Marketing.


Languages

  • English — required (you will write and present to global clients in English).
  • Portuguese — required (Brazilian market is core to our client base).
  • Spanish — strong differentiator (several key clients operate across Latin America).


Why Join SMT Advisory

Our clients are large enterprises navigating real strategic challenges — improving how they measure, understand, and act on customer experience across complex operations. The work is analytical, ambiguous, and consequential.


You will have genuine exposure to senior stakeholders at major organizations, contribute to both client delivery and internal capability-building, and work alongside a team that takes the quality of its thinking seriously.


If you're the kind of person who gets more excited by a hard question than an easy answer, this is a good place to be.


Selection Process

As part of the process, candidates will be asked to complete a short analytical case exercise. It is designed to evaluate how you structure a problem, what analytical choices you make, and how clearly you communicate your reasoning — not whether you arrive at a single \"right\" answer.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.

  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.

  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.

Oportunidade para atuar na Rede D'Or no Hospital Quinta D'or. Empresa fundada em 1977, a Rede D’Or é a maior rede privada de cuidados integrados do Brasil com presença em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Distrito Federal, Pernambuco, Maranhão, Sergipe, Pará, Paraíba, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul, Ceará, Bahia, Alagoas. O Grupo opera com 71 hospitais. A Rede possui cerca de 11 mil leitos operacionais. São, ao todo, 69,5 mil pessoas colaboradoras e 87 mil médicos credenciados, que realizaram cerca de 5,1 milhões de atendimentos de emergência, 440 mil cirurgias, 53,4 mil partos e 523 mil internações nos últimos 12 meses, além de 12,9 mil cirurgias robóticas desde o início do serviço, há cinco anos. A Rede D’Or também conta com a Oncologia D’Or e Onco Star, rede de clínicas especializadas em tratamento oncológico em oito estados brasileiros.



Sobre a Função

Responsabilidades


  • Acompanhar e administrar as autorizações pendentes de processos cirúrgicos realizados, medicamentos e prorrogações de internação, bem como assegurar que as autorizações realizadas e finalizadas estejam em conformidades com as regras comerciais de negócio;
  • Garantir a resolução de impasses técnicos entre as operadoras, seguradoras, médicos, pacientes e outros setores da Instituição, a fim de assegurar que as autorizações sejam emitidas em tempo hábil ao faturamento;
  • Responsabilizar-se pela gestão da equipe, bem como planejar, elaborar e colocar em prática as metas da área, visando alcançar os objetivos do setor e da Instituição;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o setor de Arsenal, Almoxarifado, Farmácia e Compras buscando a celeridade do processo de lançamento de material em conta;
  • Gerenciar o setor de prorrogação de contas, gerenciando a equipe de autorização, cobrando à assistência preenchimento de relatórios, e a operadora em cumprir agenda de prorrogação. Tratamento de divergências de acomodação junto aos auditores externos;



Requisitos:

  • Superior completo;
  • Desejável Pós Graduação em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência no setor de Autorização Pós;
  • Desejável habilidade em análise contratual entre Hospital e convênio;
  • Desejável conhecimento de tabela de honorários médicos e OPME;

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are looking for a Product-Led Marketing & Digital Funnels Manager to own and scale customer acquisition through paid media, webinars, and product-driven marketing funnels for our K-12 solutions.


This role is responsible for building and optimizing full-funnel digital programs from ads to webinars to product demos that generate qualified pipeline and revenue. You will operate at the intersection of product marketing, demand generation, and digital growth, turning interest into engaged prospects and customers through high-performing funnel systems.


Responsibilities

  • Own paid ads strategy across LinkedIn, Google, and retargeting to drive qualified leads
  • Manage and scale webinar programs from promotion through follow-up and conversion
  • Build and optimize digital funnels from ad to landing page to demo or sales opportunity
  • Create and improve landing pages, email nurture sequences, and conversion paths
  • Track and optimize funnel performance including conversion rates, CPL, and pipeline generated
  • Run A/B tests and scale campaigns that consistently generate pipeline


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, demand generation, or funnel management, preferably in K-12, EdTech, or SaaS
  • Proven experience running paid ads, webinars, and digital funnel programs that generate pipeline
  • Strong understanding of product-led marketing and multi-touch buyer journeys
  • Experience with marketing and CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, LinkedIn Ads, and Google Ads
  • Analytical and results-driven with a focus on conversion and revenue metrics
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
Vaga: Azure Cloud Solutions Architect


Modelo: PJ

Período: 1 ano

Local: 100% remoto

Horário: 9h às 18h


Descrição da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Azure Cloud Solutions Architect com sólida experiência em arquitetura, implantação e governança de soluções em Microsoft Azure. Este profissional atuará em ambientes complexos, colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares e garantindo a construção de soluções robustas, seguras e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Projetar, implementar e otimizar soluções em Microsoft Azure, seguindo melhores práticas de segurança, governança e arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), principalmente com Terraform (módulos, pipelines, gerenciamento de estado).
  • Atuar com Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), incluindo deploys via Helm, YAML, e práticas de observabilidade e gestão de contêineres.
  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas seguras com foco em:
  • RBAC
  • Private Endpoints
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Policy as Code
  • Construir pipelines de CI/CD usando Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Projetar soluções orientadas a eventos utilizando Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hub, Kafka e/ou Synapse.
  • Automatizar tarefas usando PowerShell, Bash e/ou Python, com foco em automações via Terraform.
  • Elaborar documentações e diagramas de arquitetura utilizando TOGAF, Diagrams.net ou ferramentas correlatas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Conhecimento avançado dos principais serviços do Azure (Compute, Network, Storage, Identity, Security, Serverless e Containers).
  • Experiência comprovada com Terraform (módulos, automação, reuso e boas práticas).
  • Domínio de AKS, Helm charts, YAML e práticas de gestão de contêineres.
  • Sólida experiência com segurança e governança em arquitetura de nuvem.
  • Vivência em CI/CD com Azure DevOps e/ou GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com integrações orientadas a eventos.
  • Scripting avançado (PowerShell, Bash, Python).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e padrões arquiteturais (ex.: TOGAF).
  • Inglês avançado.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Azure (AZ-305, AZ-104, AZ-400, etc.).
  • Experiência com FinOps e governança de custos.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura híbrida e modelos multi-cloud.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

About The Role:

Our Signals product is quickly growing, and we are scaling our Data Product team to support new customer growth and product coverage expansion through our application, data feeds and AI agent experiences. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Product Analyst to join our Data Product team. This individual will be responsible for managing a team of Data Product Analysts and will own end-to-end delivery for product initiatives, translating product goals into clear plans, leading execution, and ensuring impact across analysis, data operations, and QA workflows.


As a Senior Data Product Analyst, Team Lead, you will:

  • Own strategy and end-to-end execution for a portfolio of high-impact data product initiatives, driving measurable product value through strong product and data judgment
  • Lead a team of 2+ Data Analysts who:
  • Deliver product-facing analyses and datasets, turning messy inputs (ERP financial data, web scraped data, invoices) into clean data insights
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets and QA guidelines to measure and improve our AI and LLM powered workflows including defining quality targets, running experiments, and iterating based on results
  • Partner with Engineering to translate product needs into scalable workflows for our data products including defining business rules /requirements and improving QA / validation logic
  • Work primarily in Databricks, Google Sheets and with our proprietary AI agent tools, leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for speed, rigor, and innovation, balancing hands-on efforts yourself for the highest-impact work (complex analyses, ambiguous edge cases, AI evaluation design, and deep dive investigations) with coaching the team so execution scales beyond you
  • Own delivery planning and alignment, translate product goals into clear requirements and execution plans (scope, milestones, risks), apply strong product and data judgment to define what matters, and keep stakeholders aligned through consistent updates
  • Run delivery day to day, drive prioritization and tradeoffs across competing requests, ensure timelines are met, and track/report progress, blockers, and next steps against your plan
  • Partner cross-functionally with Data Science,Engineering, and other key teams to identify leverage points, shape solutions, and drive adoption of improvements that increase product value and operational scalability
  • Have the opportunity to grow your career in the team with increasing levels of responsibility and diversified ownership areas


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer or other technical function, including working with large datasets
  • You have 1+ years of experience leading others to deliver strong outcomes, through direct people management and/or team leadership (mentoring, coaching, setting direction, reviewing work, and driving accountability).
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of direct people management experience (including performance management)
  • You have experience working in a high-growth environment and managing many processes in parallel
  • You have experience owning end-to-end delivery for complex initiatives, applying strong product and data judgment to define success metrics, make pragmatic scope tradeoffs, and drive outcomes, including:
  • Scoping ambiguous problems
  • Building execution plans
  • Managing tradeoffs
  • Keeping stakeholders aligned through clear written and verbal updates
  • You are familiar working with large-scale datasets using Python and SQL (nice to have: PySpark, Databricks, and modern AI-assisted tools)
  • You have experience using AI and LLM tools to accelerate data work including generating/refactoring SQL and Python, exploring datasets, drafting labeling guidelines, and validating outputs before applying them to real workflows
  • You are excited to identify and pilot AI driven initiatives, turning repetitive manual work into scalable processes through automation and better tooling while balancing risks and accuracy considerations of new AI systems
  • You have experience with data transformation techniques, maintenance of data pipelines, and quality assurance techniques
  • You are excited about the potential to train and raise the team’s ability to own projects, execute independently, and deliver consistently
  • You are available to work US Eastern time zone hours
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop

title: Especialista em Control-M
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Control-M, apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e desafios, para liderar um assessment detalhado da malha de automação batch e event-driven, identificando riscos, oportunidades de melhoria e pontos de atenção. Além do assessment, você será responsável por propor, implementar e apoiar continuamente práticas robustas de sustentação, atuando lado a lado com o time de Negócios na evolução e na estabilidade do ambiente. Se você deseja contribuir de forma significativa, acredita no poder da colaboração e quer garantir a confiabilidade e a continuidade dos fluxos automatizados, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Revisar e diagnosticar a malha de jobs batch e event-driven, avaliando agendamentos, calendários, dependências, janelas batch, SLAs, integrações e governança.
  • Conduzir assessment técnico e de processo fim-a-fim, com documentação detalhada, recomendações de melhorias e plano de ação priorizado.
  • Mapear e inventariar todos os jobs nos ambientes de Produção, Homologação e Desenvolvimento, reunindo informações essenciais (nome, domínio, sistema, responsável, frequência, duração, SLA etc.).
  • Levantar e analisar estrutura de dependências (condições IN/OUT, dependências cruzadas, variáveis, recursos).
  • Identificar e documentar os componentes técnicos associados: scripts (Shell, Python, SQL), pacotes ETL, pipelines CI/CD, repositórios e versionamento.
  • Avaliar a integração e orquestração entre Control-M, ETL, Data Lake, APIs, mensageria/event triggers e eventuais outros schedulers.
  • Analisar histórico operacional, falhas, reprocessamentos, jobs long-running e incidentes.
  • Avaliar e propor melhorias em mecanismos de resiliência, incluindo estratégias de retry, backoff, compensação e políticas automáticas de correção.
  • Propor boas práticas e ajustes para sustentação do ambiente: monitoração pró-ativa, tratamento de incidentes, definição de runbooks, automação de processos de suporte e gestão de capacity.
  • Mapear arquitetura e topologia da solução, incluindo distribuição dos agents e arquitetura dos componentes Control-M (Server, EM).
  • Avaliar capacidade, performance, throughput da malha e identificar pontos de contenção.
  • Analisar políticas de alerta e escalonamento técnico, automação de correção e estratégias de continuidade (DR/BCP).
  • Avaliar segurança operacional: segregação de funções, gestão de credenciais, Vault de Secrets, trilha de auditoria, aderência a políticas (incluindo LGPD).

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (remote)
description:

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).

Requisitos

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Elastacloud (An Acora Group Company) Overview

Elastacloud (An Acoura Group Company) are a progressive full-stack full-service business technology services partner, built for the AI era. Combining the capabilities of a Managed Service Provider (MSP), Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP), IT Consulting, Professional Services and Development company, Acora helps customers achieve breakthrough results - often quicker and at lower risk than they thought possible.


We believe in a better working world, where our customers are confident to fully embrace the AI opportunity and generate economic impact.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Technical Business Analyst with strong hands-on experience in data, AI-driven projects and software, particularly in Data Transformation initiatives.


This professional will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex business needs into well-structured technical requirements and user stories. The role requires someone highly technical, delivery-oriented, and comfortable operating in Agile environments, including leading Scrum ceremonies and acting as Project Manager when required.


The position involves daily interaction with teams in Australia and regular contact with the UK, so strong English communication skills and time zone flexibility are essential.

Role Responsibilities

  • Lead requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders (Australia & UK).
  • Translate business needs into clear, structured, and technically detailed user stories.
  • Define functional and non-functional requirements for data and AI solutions.
  • Work closely with data engineers, software engineers, architects, and AI specialists.
  • Design and document data flows, process maps, integration points, and system dependencies.
  • Support Data Transformation initiatives (data migration, data modelling, governance, pipelines).
  • Define acceptance criteria and validation rules.
  • Conduct backlog refinement sessions and prioritisation workshops.
  • Lead Scrum ceremonies (planning, refinement, daily, review, retrospective).
  • Act as Project Manager when needed (timeline tracking, risk management, stakeholder reporting).
  • Support UAT coordination and solution validation.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Manage documentation in tools such as DevOps, Jira or similar.

Key Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience as Business Analyst in technical/software projects.
  • Proven experience in Data projects.
  • Technical background in:
  • Data architecture concepts
  • APIs & system integrations
  • Cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • Data modelling methodologies (BEAM, Kimbal, etc.)
  • Experience working in AI-related initiatives (ML models, automation, data pipelines, or analytics projects).
  • Experience writing detailed technical user stories for engineering teams.
  • Hands-on experience working with Agile/Scrum methodology.
  • Experience leading Scrum ceremonies.
  • Previous experience as a Project Manager would be beneficial but is not required. The core skills we are looking for are related to a Business Analyst with a focus on Data.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English (mandatory).
  • Availability to work overlapping with Australia (preferably 13:00–22:00 BRT).



Our Values

We’re proud to share the values we live by. They’re not dusty abstract concepts. Our values define our culture: they act as a promise to our customers and a constant challenge to ourselves, both as individuals and as a team, to be Game-Changers.

#1 Be the best you can be

We challenge ourselves to raise our game each day. By embracing a mindset of growth, we continuously strive to improve ourselves, our ways of working, and the service we deliver to our customers.


#2 We do what we say.

When we make a promise, we follow-through - no excuses. We don’t leave anyone hanging or walk away from challenges. Reliable and focused, we value clear communication to build trust and give customers, and colleagues, the confidence they can count on us every time.


#3 Together we win.

Business is the biggest team sport of them all. By communicating well, breaking down silos and staying aligned, we create clarity and focus. Strong relationships, shared goals and commitment make us a winning team – for each other and for our customers.


Equal Opportunities at Acora

Acora is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal opportunities regardless of race or ethnic origin, gender identity, family situation, sexual orientation, disability, religion or age. We hire our people on the basis of qualifications, merit, skills, and business need.


Acora is a Level 1 Disability Confident Committed Employer and will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request any reasonable adjustments.


Join us at Acora in creating a workplace where everyone can succeed and make an impact. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.

  • Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
  • Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: BigQuery, data lakes).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
  • Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
  • Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado:

  • Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Systems Administrator, Senior
description:
Newfold Digital empowers the world’s business owners, content publishers, and those with ideas to control their online destiny with power and confidence. We enable everyone to be able to establish their online presence. From buying a domain and setting up a website, to growing their business and presence online, we come together to make sure small businesses have all the tools and support they need to achieve their goals.


We are seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Administrator to lead the management and optimization of our Cloudflare environment and broader cloud infrastructure. This role demands hands-on expertise in Cloudflare services—DNS, WAF, CDN, caching, proxy, and security configurations—to enhance the performance and protection of our global web platforms.


You will also manage cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a strong focus on Linux/Unix systems, automation, observability, and hybrid infrastructure operations.


Key Responsibilities


Cloudflare Administration

  • Manage DNS, WAF, firewall rules, caching, and rate limiting policies
  • Optimize proxy configurations, security settings, and performance features (e.g., Argo, Workers)
  • Mitigate threats (DDoS, bots) and conduct regular audits
  • Maintain documentation and stay updated with new Cloudflare features


Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and optimize OCI or other cloud platforms (compute, storage, IAM, networking)
  • Automate deployments using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Monitor and troubleshoot performance using Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, etc


System Operations

  • Perform system maintenance and patching on Linux/Unix platforms
  • Troubleshoot OS, hardware, and database (MySQL/PostgreSQL) issues
  • Automate routine tasks via Bash, Python, or Ruby scripts

Required Skills

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on Cloudflare experience in production
  • Strong understanding of Cloudflare WAF, DNS, CDN, caching, and Zero Trust
  • Expertise in managing proxies (NGINX, HAProxy), DDoS mitigation
  • Scripting knowledge: Python, Bash, or Ruby
  • Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform), observability (Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS/SSL
  • Cloud experience with OCI or equivalent (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Experience

  • 6+ years managing hybrid cloud infrastructure
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Pages, or Load Balancing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Ansible, Puppet, or OCI CLI
  • Security/cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, Azure)


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Senior Software Engineer (Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica)
description:
Senior Software Engineer


About the Role

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.


What You'll Be Working On:

  • Lead and contribute to the ongoing migration of our customer support system from Zendesk to Gladly, with a go-live planned.
  • Develop and maintain backend services and integration layers within our Ruby on Rails monolith
  • Build and support internal integration services that connect our support platforms with core business systems
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative planning sessions
  • Own the quality of your work — writing tests, performing developer-driven QA, and ensuring production readiness without a dedicated QA engineer
  • Collaborate closely with Customer Support Representative (CSR) teams and ticketing platform stakeholders


Tech Stack:

  • Primary: Ruby, Ruby on Rails
  • Architecture: Rails monolith + separate integration services
  • Supporting: REST APIs, JSON, internal tooling


What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Ruby development skills are a must
  • Solid experience building and maintaining backend services and API integrations
  • Comfort working without a dedicated QA team you own testing and production readiness
  • Experience working in Agile environments (sprints, code reviews, ceremonies)
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with Gladly and/or Zendesk
  • Background in platform migrations
  • Full-stack exposure (React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS) beneficial for potential future team movement
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or Kafka

title: AI Engagement Manager
description:
About Dry Ground AI


Dry Ground AI designs, builds, and maintains AI-powered solutions that accelerate operational velocity for small and mid-sized businesses. Our flagship AI Velocity Plan gives clients a rapid, iterative path from concept to production. You will be the linchpin who keeps those iterations moving forward.



Why This Role Matters


As Engagement Manager, you will own the post-sale customer journey: orchestrating handoffs from Sales to Engineering, driving on-time delivery, and continually identifying new ways to create value. You are part project conductor, part trusted advisor, and part growth catalyst.


Core Responsibilities


Project Leadership

  • Lead multiple AI implementation projects from kickoff through launch and optimization.
  • Create and maintain project plans, timelines, and risk logs
  • Hold engineering and data teams accountable for sprint deliverables, escalate blockers, and manage tradeoffs between scope and schedule.


Customer Success and Relationship Management

  • Act as the main point of contact for a portfolio of AI Velocity and maintenance clients
  • Conduct regular check-ins, business reviews, and planning sessions.
  • Communicate updates clearly and translate technical milestones into business impact.


Opportunity Expansion

  • Analyze client workflows and data to uncover new AI opportunities.
  • Frame and scope these opportunities as projects to add to the Velocity backlog.
  • Collaborate with Sales to support renewals and upsells.


Process Improvement

  • Improve our delivery playbook, templates, and dashboards.
  • Promote best practices in documentation, change management, and knowledge transfer.



Required Qualifications


  • Fluent English speaking and writing skills. You will run executive meetings and prepare client-facing materials.
  • 5 or more years managing complex software or data/AI projects.
  • Strong experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success, Consulting, or Solutions Delivery.
  • Comfortable engaging with technical teams about APIs, data pipelines, and ML concepts. You do not need to code, but must bridge the gap between business and technical language.
  • Proficient with tools like Notion, Jira, and Asana.
  • Analytical thinker who can read KPIs, prioritize work, and quantify ROI.
  • Employment verification, education verification, and an international background check will be required.
  • Must be authorized to work in your local jurisdiction.



Preferred Qualifications


  • Familiarity with GenAI, LLM tools, or MLOps platforms such as LangChain, Pinecone, or vector databases.
  • Understanding of B2B SaaS commercial models.
  • Certifications like PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM are a plus.



What We Offer


  • High-impact role on a fast-moving team building innovative AI solutions.
  • Work from anywhere. We are a fully remote company with clients based in the U.S.
  • Competitive time off and flexible work environment.
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • Training and development support.
  • Work-from-home allowance.

• Experiência em testes integrados e suporte a UAT

• Comunicação clara e perfil consultivo.


Requisitos desejáveis:

• Experiência em projetos de transformação financeira ou FP&A.

title: Language Specialist
description:
Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer)

Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil)

About the Role:

As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance.
  • Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies.
  • Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains.
  • Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance.
  • Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented.
  • Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks.

Qualifications:

  • Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills.
  • Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred.
  • Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail.
  • Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

O que você deve ter?

- Mais de 7 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

O que temos pra te oferecer?

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI
description:
Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).

title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution:

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution:

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities:

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests:

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training:

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company's health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.

Who You Are:

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need:

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high-pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.

Our Culture and Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well-being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people-focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;
